children: Sweden's governing right-wing bloc is projected to win a single-seat majority in parliament in Sunday's election, public broadcaster SVT said.
SVT's projection, based on votes from 1,054 of Sweden's 6,312 election districts, gave the centre-left bloc 174 seats against 175 seats for the ruling right-wing parties.
